info.title: TV7 Engine Local API
info.description: Local-only engine sidecar API exposed on loopback. Studio starts this service and uses it as the mandatory boundary for local media compute. When TV7_ENGINE_API_TOKEN is configured, every route including health requires Authorization: Bearer <token>; the packaged app enables this. Development mode without the variable is unprotected and logs a warning.

get.description: Reports Engine-managed media readiness for Studio. ffmpeg and ffprobe are required for probe, thumbnail, and render_clip. yt-dlp is required for url_ingest and transcript.
Returns setup modes, AI provider resolution order, and installable/importable local runtime assets. Engine prefers user-installed local AI first, TV7-managed local AI second, and TV7 cloud AI third.

get.summary: Inspect current local runtime setup status
get.description: Reports detected user-installed runtimes and models, TV7-managed installable fallbacks, and capability readiness. Missing assets require explicit Studio/user action before Engine downloads or installs anything.

post.summary: Generate a thumbnail image for local media
post.description: Always overwrites the output file. Studio owns workspace paths, must pass absolute source and output paths, and must create the output parent directory before calling Engine. Optional VTT subtitles are validated inside Engine's asset workspace and burned into the clip.
Always overwrites the output file. Studio owns workspace paths, must pass absolute source and output paths, and must create the output parent directory before calling Engine.

get.summary: Stream an Engine-owned rendered MP4 by opaque export ID
get.description: Returns only a recently rendered Engine-owned MP4. IDs expire after one hour, after more than 100 exports, or when Engine restarts. A configured Engine bearer token is required on this route. Arbitrary filesystem paths are not accepted.

401.description: Engine token required or invalid when token mode is enabled

413.description: Rendered asset exceeds export size limit

post.description: Starts a local yt-dlp ingest job. URL must be public http/https; localhost and private-network hosts are rejected. The initial response is 202 with a job payload; Studio polls /v1/jobs/{id} for completion.

post.summary: Find deterministic local clip candidates from a VTT transcript
post.description: Reads a bounded Engine-owned VTT and returns chronological cue windows. These are editable candidate ranges, not viral predictions or rendered clips.

post.summary: Import a VTT transcript into Engine storage
post.description: Accepts one bounded multipart .vtt file, validates cues, and atomically stores it under Engine ownership. Browser clients do not pass filesystem paths.

201.description: Validated transcript stored under Engine ownership

post.description: Starts a local yt-dlp transcript download job. URL must be public http/https; localhost and private-network hosts are rejected. Studio polls /v1/jobs/{id} for completion.

post.summary: Start a job-backed local transcript generation
post.description: Starts local Whisper transcript generation for an imported local media file. Engine queues a job only when local transcription setup is ready. Engine never auto-downloads transcription runtimes or models from this endpoint; missing setup returns TRANSCRIPTION_SETUP_REQUIRED.

Marks a queued or running job as cancelled. Current EN-A04 cancellation is cooperative at the Engine job state boundary; process-level termination for an already-running yt-dlp child process is a follow-up hardening item.

post.summary: Store delegated TV7 cloud AI token in memory
post.description: Studio passes a short-lived Backend-issued engine:cloud_ai bearer token to Engine over loopback. Engine stores it in memory only and never returns the token value.

200.description: Delegated token metadata stored in memory

delete.summary: Clear delegated TV7 cloud AI token
delete.description: Clears the in-memory delegated cloud AI token during logout, license refresh, or revocation.

post.summary: Check TV7 cloud AI readiness through Engine
post.description: Engine validates local delegated-token state and, when present, calls Backend cloud AI execution with an Engine-shaped minimal health prompt. Studio should use this instead of calling Backend AI debug endpoints directly.

Studio-facing AI endpoint for Quick Clip-style transcript analysis. Engine owns prompt/context shaping and provider dispatch. The first executable provider path is TV7 cloud AI via Backend using an in-memory delegated token.

post.summary: Discover one bounded page of channel videos
post.description: Metadata discovery only. Returns at most 25 videos and never starts downloads. Cursor pages in increments of 25, through 475.

post.summary: Start downloads for selected channel videos
post.description: Requires explicit selection of 1 to 25 unique video IDs and canonical YouTube watch URLs. Starts one cancellable local job per selected item; omitted videos are not downloaded.

post.summary: Stream a local media file into Engine storage
post.description: Accepts one multipart file field, streams to an Engine-owned asset directory, enforces a 1 GiB limit, and removes partial files after failure. Browser clients do not pass filesystem paths.

TranscriptionSetupRequired.description: Local transcription runtime/model setup is required before transcript generation can start

available.description: null means the tool is known but not checked for this milestone.

path.description: Absolute local filesystem path to media file.

start_seconds.description: Start time of the clip in seconds. Must be >= 0 and less than end_seconds.

end_seconds.description: End time of the clip in seconds. Must be > start_seconds.

subtitle_path.description: Optional absolute .vtt path inside Engine's asset workspace. Engine shifts relevant cues to clip time and burns them into the result.

media_id.description: Optional opaque export ID for Engine-owned MP4 output, valid only while the Engine export registry retains it.

output_dir.description: Optional absolute local directory inside Engine's asset workspace. Defaults to Engine's managed asset directory.

output_template.description: Optional yt-dlp output template relative to output_dir.

transcript_path.description: Absolute .vtt path inside Engine's asset workspace; maximum 5 MiB and 20000 cues.

output_path.description: Absolute local VTT output path requested by Studio. The parent directory must exist before calling Engine.

media_path.description: Absolute local media path to transcribe.

output_path.description: Absolute local .vtt output path requested by Studio. The parent directory must exist before calling Engine.

token.description: Backend-issued delegated token. Never returned by Engine responses.

output_dir.description: Optional existing directory under the Engine asset root.

media_path.description: Engine-owned absolute path; retained for current path-based media APIs.
